message: One free key gives Claude Code 7 billion tokens a month across 600 models, and it swaps for you at the limit

lines.text: My Claude Code bill went to zero this week, and it is not a trial.
Somebody on GitHub is handing out seven billion tokens a month, across ChatGPT, Gemini, Kimi, Grok and six hundred other models.
It is called FreeLLM API, and wiring it into Claude Code takes about a minute.
The second you hit a limit it swaps you to the next model on its own, and it carries your context across.
So Claude Code just stops running out. Comment FREE and I will send you the setup.
